data: Microsoft reported fiscal 2024 revenue (year ended June 30, 2024) of about $245.1 billion, while Apple reported fiscal 2024 revenue (year ended September 28, 2024) of about $391.0 billion. Apple was therefore the larger company by sales, at roughly 1.6 times Microsoft's revenue ($391.0 billion divided by $245.1 billion is about 1.60), a gap of around $146 billion. Note that the two companies' fiscal years end at different times, so the periods are not perfectly aligned, and these figures come from my recollection of their annual reports rather than a live lookup.
